## San Diego Family Budget Plan, July 12–17, 2026

A 6-day family itinerary for 4 that keeps costs low, centers on free beaches and parks, and uses simple transit choices where practical. Estimated total is **about $1,720–$2,090** excluding airfare, depending on lodging and meal choices.

## Day-by-Day Budget Itinerary

### Day 1: Sunday, July 12 — Arrival + Waterfront Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, pick up groceries/snacks for the week.
- Afternoon: Easy walk around **Embarcadero Marina Park**, Seaport Village, and the harbor.
- Dinner: Casual tacos or burritos near downtown or Little Italy.
- Estimated spending: **$180–$260**
  - Local transit/rideshare: $20–$40
  - Food: $120–$180
  - Snacks/coffee: $20–$40

### Day 2: Monday, July 13 — Beach Day at La Jolla Shores
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Head to **La Jolla Shores** for swimming, sand play, and a picnic breakfast.
- Afternoon: Tide pools or a short coastal walk; keep it free and relaxed.
- Dinner: Budget-friendly pizza, bowls, or sandwiches on the way back.
- Estimated spending: **$110–$190**
  - Transit/parking: $10–$30
  - Food: $100–$160
  - Rentals/extra treats: $0–$20

### Day 3: Tuesday, July 14 — Museum Day at Balboa Park
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **The San Diego Museum of Us** or **Natural History Museum**; choose one paid museum to stay on budget.
- Afternoon: Free time in **Balboa Park** gardens, playgrounds, and outdoor spaces.
- Dinner: Early dinner in North Park or a simple grocery-store picnic.
- Estimated spending: **$150–$240**
  - Museum tickets: $60–$100
  - Transit/parking: $10–$25
  - Food: $80–$115

### Day 4: Wednesday, July 15 — Old Town + Mission Bay Free Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Explore **Old Town San Diego State Historic Park**.
Media: Alt=Morning: Explore **Old Town San Diego State Historic Park**, Estimated Spending
- Afternoon: Head to **Mission Bay Park** for biking, playgrounds, or a shoreline stroll.
- Dinner: Tacos, rotisserie chicken, or grocery picnic near the bay.
- Estimated spending: **$90–$170**
  - Transit: $10–$25
  - Food: $80–$140
  - Optional bike rental: $0–$20

### Day 5: Thursday, July 16 — Zoo Area Without the Zoo Price Tag
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Walk the free areas around **Balboa Park**, including the botanical garden exterior and Cabrillo Bridge views.
Media: Alt=Morning: Walk the free areas around **Balboa Park**, including the botanical garden exterior and Cabrillo Bridge views, Estimated Spending
- Afternoon: Free museum option if available that day, or playground/picnic time.
- Dinner: Low-cost Mexican food or sandwich shop.
- Estimated spending: **$100–$190**
  - Transit/parking: $10–$25
  - Food: $90–$150
  - Optional paid add-on: $0–$20

### Day 6: Friday, July 17 — Coronado + Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Ferry or drive to **Coronado** and enjoy the beach and Hotel del Coronado exterior.
- Afternoon: Lunch, then head to the airport or continue travel.
- Dinner: Depending on departure time, grab airport food or a final casual meal.
- Estimated spending: **$150–$240**
  - Ferry/parking/transit: $20–$50
  - Food: $100–$170
  - Snacks/coffee: $20–$20

## Cost Breakdown for the Full Trip

| Category | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Lodging, 5 nights | $750–$1,150 |
| Food and groceries | $500–$700 |
| Local transit, parking, ferry, rides | $80–$180 |
| Museum admission and small extras | $120–$220 |
| Beach/picnic supplies and incidentals | $70–$140 |
| Total estimated trip cost | **$1,720–$2,390** |

To stay safely under **$2,200**, aim for:
- Lodging at or below **$1,000 total**
- Mostly grocery breakfasts and picnic lunches
- One paid museum only
- Free beaches, parks, and waterfront walks for most afternoons

## Budget-Friendly Meal Ideas

- Breakfast: cereal, yogurt, fruit, bagels, breakfast sandwiches from groceries
- Lunch: picnic wraps, PB&J, rotisserie chicken, fruit, chips
- Dinner: tacos, pizza, burritos, noodle bowls, or family-style casual spots
- Beach day packing list: water bottles, sunscreen, snacks, sandwiches, fruit, wet wipes

## Transit Tips for a Family of 4

- Stay near **downtown, Little Italy, Mission Valley, or Old Town** to reduce car use.
- Use **MTS trolleys/buses** for Balboa Park, Old Town, and downtown when convenient.
- For beach days, a **rental car only on select days** can be cheaper than daily rideshares.
Media: Alt=For beach days, a **rental car only on select days** can be cheaper than daily rideshares, Estimated Spending
- If you do not rent a car, combine **trolley + rideshare** for La Jolla and Coronado.
- Park once and stay longer in each area to avoid repeated parking fees.

- San Diego tourism guide: https://www.sandiego.org/
